dogecoin.text:
Got so many msgs on #dogecoin suddenly and some are disappointed. Dude i am not crypto expert. 
But
Everyone who has been in this market (me since 2016) has got their butt burned one day or other for not holding or not selling. That is it. See the coin, see project, not the mood

People who are losing money in #dogecoin , i will again say. Ambition of project and nature of crypto matters. Unless it is creating value it will not keep gains. 

Having said that, this is story of coins, you will burn your hand then make money.
